toegepas.na: Party van die goud word weer
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Party' sits awkwardly before the mass noun 'goud'; 'party van die goud' is the natural form and keeps the qualifier.
toegepas.fout: 'Party goud' puts the countable quantifier 'party' bare before the mass noun 'goud', which reads stiffly.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Party van die goud' is the natural Afrikaans form, keeps the qualifier and the meaning, and touches no protected wording.

na_skrywer.na: waar ander metale uit ru goud
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: A glossary entry is read on its own, so 'die ander metale' refers to nothing named before it; without 'die' it stands alone.
na_skrywer.fout: Read on its own, the definition's 'die ander metale' points back to metals the entry never names.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The point may be real, but this rewords a glossary definition beyond a spelling or grammar error, so the writer must decide it for every lesson that shares the entry.

laat_vaar_vorige.na: en die werk in die myn laat doen
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'sy' could refer to the business or the mine; naming the mine's work removes the ambiguity without changing the meaning.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'sy' naturally points to the mine and either reading means the same, while 'in die myn' narrows the work to underground and rewords a shared glossary definition.
